description: This file defines the MobileAppService class, which provides methods for managing mobile applications and bundles via HTTP requests in an Angular application. It includes functions for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting mobile apps and bundles, as well as managing OAuth2 clients.

classes.name: MobileAppService
classes.description: Angular service class for managing mobile applications and bundles through HTTP API calls.

methods.name: saveMobileApp
methods.description: Saves a new MobileApp object via POST request.

methods.name: getTenantMobileAppInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of MobileApp info, optionally filtered by platform type.

methods.name: getMobileAppInfoById
methods.description: Fetches MobileApp details by its ID.

methods.name: deleteMobileApp
methods.description: Deletes a MobileApp by its ID.

methods.name: saveMobileAppBundle
methods.description: Creates or updates a MobileAppBundle, optionally associating OAuth2 client IDs.

methods.name: updateOauth2Clients
methods.description: Updates OAuth2 client IDs associated with a MobileAppBundle.

methods.name: getTenantMobileAppBundleInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of MobileAppBundleInfo objects.

methods.name: deleteMobileAppBundle
methods.description: Deletes a MobileAppBundle by its ID.
